executiveSummary: Panama experienced a major M7+ earthquake sequence prompting nationwide evacuations; authorities confirmed at least one death and more than 6,000 people affected. View Article Source Catastrophic urban flooding in Istanbul killed at least four people, inundated homes and businesses, and forced large-scale rescues and evacuations. View Article Along Mexico's Pacific coast, Hurricane Trudy and associated storms caused at least six deaths and continue to pose life-threatening flood and landslide risks in Colima and Jalisco. View Article Security Advisory El Niño-linked river flooding displaced thousands across northern Argentina, southern Paraguay (Ayolas), and western Uruguay; additional evacuations and protective works are ongoing. View Article Wind-driven wildfires in Southern California led to approximately 16,000 evacuations and damaged or destroyed at least six homes; utilities conducted large precautionary power shutoffs. Source Supporting Report In Nepal's Gorkha district, sudden glacial/river flooding left at least five people missing, stranded over 100 foreign trekkers, and damaged bridges and hydropower works. View Article Source Wildfire conditions in East Java, Indonesia caused four responder fatalities and serious burn injuries amid broader haze impacts. View Article In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Hurricane Isaias resulted in at least six deaths and widespread power outages across Florida and Alabama. View Article

outlook72h: Pacific Mexico: Maintain high readiness for additional heavy rainfall, flash flooding, and landslides in Colima/Jalisco as Trudy's influence persists. Security Advisory Panama: Expect continued aftershocks; prioritize safety checks for previously damaged buildings and critical lifelines. Source Southern Cone (Argentina/Paraguay/Uruguay): Rivers remain elevated; additional localized evacuations and protective drainage works likely where rains persist. View Article Southern California: Elevated fire-weather conditions may recur where winds align with dry fuels; watch for new ignitions and potential utility shutoffs. View Article Nepal (Gorkha): Access restoration and bridge inspections will be critical; localized rainfall could trigger additional slides or delays to aid delivery.
